_about: Model providers a vector database can send chunk text to on its own (store-side vectorizers, embedding functions, rerankers, generative modules). Every statement quotes or closely paraphrases the provider's own current documentation, with its URL. A statement that could not be verified is null: VecShield never fills it in. Statements are context for a reviewer, never an observation of this customer's account or contract.

_classes.third_party_processor: A company other than the store's operator and other than the customer's own cloud tenant receives the text.
_classes.customer_cloud_service: A model service inside the customer's own cloud account or tenant (for example Azure OpenAI in the customer's subscription, Amazon Bedrock in the customer's account, Vertex AI in the customer's project).
_classes.store_operator: The store's own operator runs the model (for example Pinecone Inference for a Pinecone index). No new company receives the text, but the processing is a separate service to confirm under the existing DPA/BAA.
_classes.local: A model the customer runs (a local container, Ollama, a self-hosted inference server). No provider receives the text.

openai.legal_entity: OpenAI OpCo, LLC (customers outside the EEA/Switzerland); OpenAI Ireland Ltd. (customers in the EEA/Switzerland)

training_use.statement: As of March 1, 2023, data sent to the OpenAI API is not used to train or improve OpenAI models unless the customer explicitly opts in.

retention.statement: Abuse monitoring logs are retained for up to 30 days unless longer retention is required by law; /v1/embeddings keeps no application state and is eligible for Zero Data Retention; /v1/vector_stores keeps application state until deleted.

baa.statement: OpenAI documents a process to request a Business Associate Agreement for the API services; coverage depends on the eligible endpoints and data-retention controls agreed.

eu_residency.statement: Data residency projects are offered for Europe (eu.api.openai.com) and other regions.

azure_openai.display_name: Azure OpenAI (Foundry Models sold by Azure)

training_use.statement: Prompts, completions and embeddings are not available to OpenAI or other model providers, and are not used to train generative AI foundation models without the customer's permission or instruction.

retention.statement: Models are stateless. Prompts and completions may be stored for abuse monitoring in the resource's geography unless the customer is approved for modified abuse monitoring; stateful features store data in the customer's resource until deleted.

baa.statement: Microsoft offers the HIPAA BAA to covered entities and business associates by default through the Product Terms and DPA, for in-scope Azure services.

eu_residency.statement: Prompts and responses are processed within the customer-specified geography, except for Global deployments (any geography where the model is deployed) and DataZone deployments (any geography within the data zone, e.g. the EU).

training_use.statement: Model providers have no access to the Bedrock model deployment accounts, Bedrock logs, or customer prompts and completions.

retention.statement: Retention is set by a per-Region data retention mode (none, default, aws_review); some models require retention of up to 30 days for AWS review. With cross-region inference, retained inputs and outputs are stored in the destination Regions.

eu_residency.statement: Requests are served in the Region called; cross-region inference processes (and retains, where applicable) data in destination Regions.

google_vertex.display_name: Google Vertex AI / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
notes: Google documents that regional and global endpoints do not guarantee data residency or in-region ML processing; only the multi-region endpoints keep ML processing within the US or EU boundary. VecShield therefore infers a jurisdiction only from those two hosts.

training_use.statement: Google won't use customer data to train or fine-tune any AI/ML models without prior permission or instruction.

retention.statement: Google may log prompts for abuse monitoring (an exception can be requested); request-response logging is off by default; zero data retention requires specific customer actions.

baa.statement: Google enters into BAAs as necessary under HIPAA; Generative AI on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform is a covered product.

eu_residency.statement: The EU multi-region endpoint keeps ML processing within the European Union.

training_use.statement: Unpaid services: Google uses submitted content and responses to improve its products and machine learning, and human reviewers may read it. Paid services: prompts and responses are not used to improve Google's products. In the EEA, Switzerland and the UK the paid-services terms apply to all use.

retention.statement: For paid services Google logs prompts and responses for a limited period for abuse detection; this data may be stored transiently or cached in any country in which Google or its agents maintain facilities.

eu_residency.statement: The terms allow transient storage or caching in any country where Google or its agents maintain facilities.

notes: The Gemini API terms prohibit use in clinical practice or to provide medical advice.

training_use.statement: Customers can opt out of prompts and generations being used to train Cohere models in dashboard Data Controls; the policy does not state the default.

retention.statement: Logged prompts and generations are deleted after 30 days unless required by law or contract or flagged for misuse; zero data retention is available to approved enterprise customers.

voyageai.operator: Voyage AI (acquired by MongoDB, Inc., February 2025)

training_use.statement: Customers can opt out of Voyage storing and using their data for future model training, giving zero-day retention; the dashboard toggle is 'Opted In' until changed.

retention.statement: Opting out gives zero-day retention of API data.

mongodb_autoembed.display_name: MongoDB Vector Search Automated Embedding (Voyage AI models)

training_use.statement: MongoDB does not use any customer data from Automated Embedding to train its models at this time.

notes: MongoDB does not document where Automated Embedding inference runs. Self-managed deployments call Voyage AI with customer-supplied API keys.

jina.operator: Jina AI GmbH (acquired by Elastic N.V., October 2025)

training_use.statement: Jina AI does not use customer request data, inputs, prompts or uploaded content to train its models.

retention.statement: Input or output is stored only to the extent required to provide the services; operational, diagnostic and usage metadata may be retained. The applicable DPA is the Elastic Customer DPA.

huggingface.display_name: Hugging Face Inference Providers / Inference API

training_use.statement: Hugging Face does not store user data for training; requests may be routed to external inference providers whose own data policies apply.

retention.statement: Request bodies and responses are not stored when routing; debugging logs without user data are kept up to 30 days.

notes: Routed requests reach a further third-party inference provider; the sub-processor chain is longer than one company.

training_use.statement: In free mode Mistral may use API input and output to train its models unless the customer opts out; pay-as-you-go customers can opt out at any time.

retention.statement: Zero data retention is available on paid plans for supported stateless API calls.

training_use.statement: Trial terms s3.3: NVIDIA collects User Content and Generated Content to improve NVIDIA products and services, including AI models.

retention.statement: Trial terms s1.2 and s2.3: trial use only, not in production; NVIDIA does not store or use User Content at the end of each session except as disclosed for specific services (e.g. fine-tuning).

notes: A self-hosted NIM container is a local model, not this service; the connector should report it as provider 'self_hosted'.

training_use.statement: By default Anthropic does not use inputs or outputs from commercial products such as the API to train its models.

retention.statement: API inputs and outputs are deleted within 30 days, except for services with longer retention under customer control, agreed zero data retention, Usage Policy enforcement, or legal requirements; Covered Models require limited retention.

baa.statement: Anthropic offers a BAA for HIPAA-ready services, including the first-party API; not every API feature is covered.
Pinecone offers HIPAA compliance with a Business Associate Addendum (included in Enterprise, an add-on on Standard).

notes: Pinecone hosts its inference models on its own infrastructure alongside the database.

eu_residency.statement: Inference runs within the EU for European clusters and in the US for all other regions; free models are US-only. External-provider models are proxied to that provider.

notes: An unidentified external endpoint is treated as a third party until the customer declares otherwise.
